page.layout: One page of text, set in verse. Running head at top centre, page number top left. Below the text, a poem title in capitals, then a sub-title and a second poem. Catchword at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Ebria profuso quod tota cruore piorum,
Immani rictu viscera sancta vorat.
Crudeles Lanij, Periuri, Perfidiosi,
Frustra intentantes armas, vimq; Deo,
Aut sapite, aut properate mori: nam vindice dextra
Eripiet vestro seque suosq; iugo.
A. I. S.
AD SYPERIVM,
AVRELIENSIVM MVRO-
RVM DESTRVCTOREM.
Moenibus extructis validis, & turribus urbes
Cingere, erat veteri gloria, mosq; ducum:
Moenibus euersis, Infontis & arcibus urbis
Tu contra o Syperi nomina clara petis,
Et voti es compos: parta est tibi fama perennis:
Quae viget ex ipso nomine[?] interitu.
Sed qualis? Qualem qui incendit tecta Dianae
Rettulit, aut Tenedos quam dedit Æacidæ.
IN EVNDEM.
Qui requiem saxis vivens inuidit, & amplæ
Qui decus ex urbis quæsiit excidio:
Inuisum cunctis caput occidit, atque superba Æternum saxo colla premenda dedit.

page.notes: The underlines beneath "Quae" and "Qui" are printed emphasis marks, not text. The faint text at the right edge and upper right is show-through from the facing page and is left out. "nomine" is a doubtful reading: the scan looks like "nomior", so the word is marked [?]. The catchword "IN" at lower right is cut off at the edge. The poem's first lines and the 'M' initial are read as printed; "Lanij" and "Æacidæ" are read from a small scan.
